lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 你好，我想买两张火车票。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng zhāng huǒchē piào.
lines.english: Hello, I want to buy two train tickets.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 明天的票卖完了。后天有票。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān de piào mài wán le. Hòutiān yǒu piào.
lines.english: Tomorrow's tickets sold out. Day after tomorrow has tickets.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà mǎi hòutiān de ba. Duōshao qián?
lines.english: Then buy day after tomorrow's. How much?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 一张一百块，两张两百块。
lines.pinyin: Yī zhāng yībǎi kuài, liǎng zhāng liǎngbǎi kuài.
lines.english: One ticket one hundred, two tickets two hundred.
